title: Canonical ordinary integral counit on flat-term K-flat complexes
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l, and a morphism f:X→Y of schemes. Use the completed integral coefficient sheaves B_X and B_Y, the published ordinary module pullback f_B^* [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction], and its ordinary unbounded total left derived functor with its universal counit [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback]. For every cochain complex P of B_Y-module sheaves which is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex] and has flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the canonical cochain computation map ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit, from Lf_B^*([P]) to [f_B^*P], is an isomorphism. The cochain computation map uses the canonical cochain-to-homotopy localization isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. This statement has no constructibility, Noetherian, boundedness or completeness hypothesis on P.

proof.text: Use the completed structural ring map and the ordinary module pullback adjunction of [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction]. This is the ordinary ringed pullback: exact inverse image of modules followed by extension of scalars. The tensor construction and the published sheafified Kan-extension construction have the same right adjoint, so their canonical comparison is a natural isomorphism compatible with the adjunction units.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback] to this ringed morphism. It provides a total left derived functor whose computation counit is invertible on every complex that is K-flat and has flat terms. Transport along the natural isomorphism in step 1 if necessary; no flatness of the structural ring map is required.

proof.text: The published ordinaryIntegralDerivedPull and ordinaryIntegralPullCounit are the specified total left derived functor and its universal counit [def-sf-ordinary-integral-derived-pullback]. Uniqueness of the right Kan extension gives the unique isomorphism to the pair of step 2, commuting with these counits. Hence the specified counit is invertible on the same good complexes.

proof.text: The cochain computation map ordinaryIntegralPullComplexCounit is this counit composed with the canonical quotient-to-homotopy localization isomorphisms. All other factors are isomorphisms, proving the assertion.
